crossRefs.note: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
King David was told, “Yahweh has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So…
David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments…
David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed…

translations.web: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
translations.bsb: They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
translations.kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
translations.asv: They have seen thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
